note: Adapted from the species description no. 274 in Chhotani (1997), Fauna of India: Isoptera. The original is in English; the alate description is cited from the literature and is not based on specimens. Only the alate is known; soldier, worker and nymph are lacking. The number of antennal segments is given in the original as “Antennae? segmented”, i.e. not stated. Synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate relatively large; head capsule elongate-oval and narrowing anteriorly; pronotum very large, strongly convex in anterior and middle parts, distinctly concave at middle, anterolateral corners angular; postclypeus large and strongly convex, about half as long as wide; posterior notch of mesonotum deeper than that of metanotum; media of forewing arising at the wing scales, with 2–3 branches in the distal third.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head light brown, slightly paler anteriorly; postclypeus, antennae, pronotum, anterior parts of meso- and metanotum, legs and ventral surface of body yellow; remaining body light brown; wings slightly yellowish. Pilosity moderately dense; a few hairs near the wing apex. Body length with wings 17.0 mm, without wings 10.0 mm. Head elongate-oval, narrowing anteriorly (1.6 mm to the tip of the labrum, 1.48 mm wide). Fontanelle indistinct, a pale spot. Compound eyes medium-sized, protruding. Ocellus medium-sized; separated from compound eye by half its diameter. Postclypeus large, strongly convex; about half as long as wide; anterior margin slightly convex. Number of antennal segments not stated in the original description; segments 2, 3 and 4 subequal in length, segment 5 shorter than segment 4. Pronotum very large, strongly convex in anterior and middle parts, distinctly concave at middle; anterolateral corners angular (0.95 mm long, 1.44 mm wide). Posterior notch of mesonotum deeper than that of metanotum. Media of forewing arising at the wing scales, with 2–3 branches in the distal third; forewing 14.0 mm long.
